alignment: same simulator frame and timestamp, same K and camera pose for all four sensors
annotation_requirements: Verify CARLA instance encoding and actor-ID relationship empirically on known spawned actors before export; reject ambiguous IDs
Use visible instance pixels for visible bounding boxes, preserve projected 3D extent separately as amodal geometry
Clip 3D boxes against camera near plane before projection; discard behind-camera geometry, clip coordinates to image bounds
Check semantic class and depth consistency against instance mask; manually inspect collisions or mismatches
Store instance ID, actor ID, class taxonomy version, visible pixel count, visible bbox, amodal projected bbox, truncation and visibility policy
Treat ambiguous, tiny, heavily occluded and incomplete objects explicitly as ignore under a pre-frozen policy; do not silently relabel as negatives
Label traffic-light state separately from traffic-light object presence with facing/direction and visibility; raw semantic mask does not encode signal state
Store intentional empty negative images; do not select only images containing target objects
pilot_before_threshold_freeze: 32 synchronized sensors instead of 24: five-frame probe, own-payload queue safety, GPU/timeout/frame/PNG audit and known-actor visibility checks. Retain prior dataset unchanged.
manual_qa: review every pilot instance, then a recorded stratified sample by class/weather/occlusion/truncation with corrections versioned before training
split: whole episodes and connected spatial route groups; reserve new town/weather/actor seeds for lockbox; never split frames randomly
prohibited_shortcuts: semantic connected components used as instance truth
all projected 3D boxes treated as visible
test used for thresholds or hyperparameters
simulator signal state passed into learned inference
